params.name: corner_r
params.comment: Vertical corner radius of the body

params.name: top_r
params.comment: Radius of the rounded top edges

params.name: plate_z
params.comment: Ground clearance under the chassis plate

params.name: plate_t
params.comment: Chassis plate thickness (6 mm birch ply)

params.name: wheel_y
params.comment: Wheel centre |Y| (half wheelbase); motors just inside the front/rear walls

params.name: shaft_off
params.comment: Output shaft offset from the motor axis (SRC drawing)

params.name: motor_z
params.comment: Motor axis height (shaft below the axis)

params.name: pack_y
params.comment: Pack length Y (2 cells end to end + nickel)

params.name: tof_r
params.comment: Cliff sensor distance from the centre (under the plate)

params.name: pan_y
params.comment: Head pan axis Y (forward of centre; the pan gear clears the spine)

params.name: pan_servo_x
params.comment: Pan servo shaft X (1:1 gear pair, 36 mm centre distance)

params.name: pi_xc
params.comment: Pi 5 PCB centre X (USB/Ethernet edge faces +X, ~40 mm plug room)

params.name: shaft_od
params.comment: Pan shaft: 25 x 1 mm aluminium tube (fits 6805 bearings)

params.name: mag_d
params.comment: Magnet diameter (6 x 3 mm N52 disc)

params.name: scan_h
params.comment: LD19 scan plane above its mounting ears (EST from the datasheet figure)

params.name: plinth_h
params.comment: Plinth height above the body top

params.name: head_w
params.comment: Head width (photo match; the original brief asked for smaller)

params.name: head_z0
params.comment: Head bottom Z (clears the turret at any tilt)

params.name: gear_z
params.comment: Pan gear pair bottom Z (under the top deck)

params.name: body_h
params.comment: Body box height (1.25 x width, as in the target photo)

params.name: wheel_gap
params.comment: Body side to wheel inner face

params.name: sled_y0
params.comment: Sled rear face (the door screws on here)

params.name: sled_y1
params.comment: Sled front face Y (XT60 male sticks out here)

params.name: tun_hw
params.comment: Battery tunnel half-width (notches in the spine and rear plate)

params.name: ply_t
params.comment: Frame ply thickness (4 mm birch ply)

params.name: notch_z
params.comment: Spine notch top (XT60 + sled front pass under)

params.name: rnotch_z
params.comment: Rear plate notch top (pack + BMS + fuse pass under)

params.name: wall_top
params.comment: Seam between the walls and the top halves

params.name: wall_seam_y
params.comment: Seam between the front/rear walls and the side walls

params.name: drv_z
params.comment: Driver board bottom Z (above the front motors)

params.name: knuckle_h
params.comment: Knuckle between plinth and turret (the lidar plane passes here)

params.name: pod_top
params.comment: Pod rim Z (5 mm under the LD19 window band)

params.name: lidar_x
params.comment: Lidar centre X (rear left, as in the target photo)

params.name: top_seam_y
params.comment: Seam between the front and rear top halves

params.name: frame_z1
params.comment: Bottom of the cheeks and rear plate (clear of the motor mounts)
